tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation refuted the fitted stationary model, while the paid rows show a steep collapse and sign change at high gradient. The available evidence and probes do not support a quantitatively confirmed stationary law, so abstain rather than overfit.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise to a stationary gradient-inhibition or threshold model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The attempted stationary threshold model failed fresh confirmation badly (RMSE 0.738126 versus tolerance 0.045), and u_now and s_grad remain coupled, so the observations do not identify a reliable alternative.
The remaining listed probes are either nuisance-only or a fine trajectory batch; neither resolves the confounding of u_now and s_grad or the fresh-confirmation failure.
